_basis.text: Annual turnover or revenue is determined from the FY2022 audited financial statements, or the YA2022 tax return where there are no audited accounts. If the FY2022 accounting year-end changed, turnover is pro-rated to a 12-month period.
_basis.note: Once determined, later changes in turnover do not change the obligation (s1.5, p13).
